# VoxBridge Compose 0.3.0

This release makes Faster Whisper/CTranslate2 the default speech-recognition
path and substantially improves live refinement, provider switching, workflow
controls, and hardware status reporting.

## Highlights

- Adds Faster Whisper recognition through VoxBridge, using CUDA FP16 when
  available and CPU INT8 as a fallback. The existing whisper.cpp/Vulkan path
  remains available for broad hardware compatibility.
- Adds managed speech-model selection, complete-download validation, preload and
  warmup handling, and accurate progress while models are prepared.
- Reworks live refinement around a confirmed prefix and revisable recent tail.
  Model work is serialized, newly recognized speech is coalesced, and stale
  results cannot overwrite later dictation.
- Adds safeguards against duplicated or moved phrases, copied context, malformed
  joins, paragraph collapse, prompt leakage, and unstable splice boundaries.
- Makes embedded and remote Ollama switching generation-aware so recording can
  continue without an older initialization or result restoring the wrong
  provider.
- Adds a compact global Start/Stop control, a vertical live microphone meter,
  backend/model details on status hover, and a confirmed workspace-clear action.
- Consolidates refinement history, copy, fidelity, and offload controls while
  keeping the raw and refined documents as the primary workspace.
- Expands Status with processor activity, system memory, graphics-memory
  allocation, recognition/refinement estimates, and pipeline counters.
- Adds whole-document topic filename suggestions with a safe local fallback.

## Compatibility notes

- Existing settings and custom refinement-model paths are preserved.
- Existing downloaded model files are not deleted.
- Network Ollama remains supported and receives transcript text only, never
  recorded audio.
- Windows is the primary tested platform. Linux packages remain available for
  broader testing.

## Credits

VoxBridge Compose is an independently maintained derivative of
[FOSS Voquill](https://voquill.org/) by Jack Brumley and its contributors.
Please consider [supporting the original project](https://voquill.org/donate.html).

Faster Whisper is provided by
[faster-whisper](https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper) and
[CTranslate2](https://github.com/OpenNMT/CTranslate2). Embedded refinement uses
[Qwen3 4B Instruct 2507](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507),
distributed in GGUF form by
[Unsloth](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-GGUF).

The independently implemented streaming architecture was informed by the
incremental-recognition and bounded-revision research credited in the
repository's NOTICE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES files.
